target.confidence: A for control flow and field use; B for conditional probability model

branches.operation: For each ItemList[i], process Prob[i] repetitions. A direct Item produces one ItemStruct per repetition; a child DropClass is pushed onto the explicit mLootGroup stack per repetition. Picks magnitude and NoDrop are not used.
Dispatch AddMetaLoot for dynamic candidate discovery, battle-context filters, NoDrop gate and weighted selection. ItemList=[0] is a sentinel, not an Item ID.

For each of Picks draws, sample Range(0, NoDrop+sum(Prob)); if r<NoDrop emit nothing; otherwise call GetProbability(mRandom,Prob) and resolve ItemList[selectedIndex] to one direct Item or a nested DropClass.

nested_groups: Explicit LIFO mLootGroup stack; DropPropManager.GetItem resolves each popped DropClass. Child groups run their own Picks/NoDrop/IsADC branch. No direct recursive BL call.
normalization: No fixed 100 or 10000 normalization in ordinary DropProp selection.
drop_weight_param: 10000 is divided by Item.ItemValue to form dynamic IsADC candidate weights in CheckItem; it is not a scale for ordinary Prob.
output_scope: pre CheckItemLimit, pickup and server reward handling
unresolved: Dynamic IsADC eligible candidates and final per-Item rates require Section, unit and item-limit state.
CheckItemLimit, quality transforms and other downstream handling can alter emitted results.
Section.DropValueID and server FightDataProfile.dropValues remain separate, unresolved systems.
